The Artist

This is Jelani2o9.

Jelani2o9 is a Stockton born rapper and songwriter. Coming from the valley hasn't always been easy, but through family, faith, and love a new path was paved.

Jelani writes music from the heart, with the aim to bridge life's many blessings with the hardships and struggles that come along the way. Jelani aims to bring wisdom, personal experiences, and good flows to your ears — all through the Grace of the Most High.
